title: Complete and total waste of money
text: Complete and total waste of money. I thought this might make my life easier. I have to open cans a couple times a day. This did not even open one can after trying over and over again! The only way to get the lid off the can was to pull out the old rusty can opener and go over what I just did with this product. It seems to seal the lid right onto the can. I could turn the can upside down and not even a drop of the contents would come out. Once I used my old can opener, it seemed to break the seal somehow. Well the whole point of getting a new one was to throw the old one out. I threw the new one out! I ordered just a good old-fashioned can opener and it's fine but this is terrible! Who knows whether it's sturdy or durable. I only used it for a couple weeks and it's still in one piece. I don't think that gives you an idea of whether it is sturdy or durable. Any can opener should last 2 weeks
